In 1908 , the first five - day workweek in the United States was instituted by a New England cotton mill so that Jewish workers would not have to work on the Sabbath from sundown Friday to sundown Saturday .

A board of directors is a recognized group of people who jointly oversee the activities of an organization
A board of directors is a recognized group of people who jointly oversee the activities of an organization
which can be either a for - profit business , nonprofit organization , or a government agency .

Such a board 's powers , duties , and responsibilities are determined by government regulations ( including the jurisdiction 's corporations law ) and the organization 's own constitution and bylaws .
